import Transformer.GPTMini.RMSNorm
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.MeanValue
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Deriv.Inv
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Sqrt

/-!
A sharper real-arithmetic Lipschitz bound for the unchanged parameter-free
finite-epsilon RMS operation. The previous checked bound was 2/sqrt(eps).
The proof keeps the radial and angular contributions separate instead of
bounding both by a triangle inequality. No floating-point or learning claim.
-/

namespace Early99Normalization

open Transformer Real

/-- Radial scalar map whose derivative is at most one. -/
noncomputable def radialScalar (c t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt c * t / Real.sqrt (t ^ 2 + c)

/-- Exact derivative of the scalar map for every real t and positive c. -/
theorem radialScalar_hasDerivAt (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (radialScalar c)
      (Real.sqrt c * c / (Real.sqrt (t ^ 2 + c)) ^ 3) t := by
  have hp : 0 < t ^ 2 + c := by positivity
  have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt (t ^ 2 + c) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hp
  have hnum := (hasDerivAt_id t).const_mul (Real.sqrt c)
  have hden := (((hasDerivAt_id t).pow 2).add_const c).sqrt hp.ne'
  have h : HasDerivAt (radialScalar c)
    ((Real.sqrt c * Real.sqrt (t ^ 2 + c) -
      (Real.sqrt c * t) * (2 * t / (2 * Real.sqrt (t ^ 2 + c)))) /
      Real.sqrt (t ^ 2 + c) ^ 2) t := by
    convert! hnum.fun_div hden hs.ne' using 1
    simp
  convert h using 1
  field_simp [hs.ne']
  nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt hp.le]

/-- Positive epsilon makes the radial scalar function globally nonexpansive. -/
theorem radialScalar_lipschitz (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    LipschitzWith 1 (radialScalar c) := by
  apply lipschitzWith_of_nnnorm_deriv_le
  · intro t
    exact (radialScalar_hasDerivAt c hc t).differentiableAt
  · intro t
    change ‖deriv (radialScalar c) t‖ ≤ (1 : ℝ)
    rw [(radialScalar_hasDerivAt c hc t).deriv, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    have hp : 0 < t ^ 2 + c := by positivity
    have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt (t ^ 2 + c) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hp
    have hlow : Real.sqrt c ≤ Real.sqrt (t ^ 2 + c) :=
      Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg t])
    have henergy : c ≤ Real.sqrt (t ^ 2 + c) ^ 2 := by
      rw [Real.sq_sqrt hp.le]
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg t]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (pow_pos hs 3)).mpr
    have hm := mul_le_mul hlow henergy hc.le hs.le
    nlinarith [hm]

/-- Vector map with the same radial scalar function, before RMS rescaling. -/
noncomputable def radialMap {d : ℕ} (c : ℝ) (x : EucSpace d) : EucSpace d :=
  (Real.sqrt c / Real.sqrt (‖x‖ ^ 2 + c)) • x

/-- Radial and angular distances both contract; no triangle factor is lost. -/
theorem radialMap_nonexpansive {d : ℕ} (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (x y : EucSpace d) : ‖radialMap c x - radialMap c y‖ ≤ ‖x - y‖ := by
  set a := Real.sqrt (‖x‖ ^ 2 + c) with ha
  set b := Real.sqrt (‖y‖ ^ 2 + c) with hb
  have ha0 : 0 < a := by dsimp [a]; positivity
  have hb0 : 0 < b := by dsimp [b]; positivity
  have hca : Real.sqrt c ≤ a := by
    apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖x‖]
  have hcb : Real.sqrt c ≤ b := by
    apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖y‖]
  set u := Real.sqrt c / a with hu
  set v := Real.sqrt c / b with hv
  have hu0 : 0 ≤ u := by dsimp [u]; positivity
  have hv0 : 0 ≤ v := by dsimp [v]; positivity
  have huv : u * v ≤ 1 := by
    dsimp [u, v]
    rw [div_mul_div_comm]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (mul_pos ha0 hb0)).mpr
    have h := mul_le_mul hca hcb (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) ha0.le
    nlinarith [h]
  have hscalar := (radialScalar_lipschitz c hc).norm_sub_le ‖x‖ ‖y‖
  have hscalar' : |u * ‖x‖ - v * ‖y‖| ≤ |‖x‖ - ‖y‖| := by
    simpa [radialScalar, u, v, a, b, Real.norm_eq_abs, div_mul_eq_mul_div] using hscalar
  have hsquare := sq_le_sq.mpr hscalar'
  have hgap : 0 ≤ ‖x‖ * ‖y‖ - inner ℝ x y := by
    linarith [real_inner_le_norm x y]
  have hangular :
      2 * (u * v) * (‖x‖ * ‖y‖ - inner ℝ x y) ≤
      2 * (‖x‖ * ‖y‖ - inner ℝ x y) := by
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr huv) hgap]
  have hresult : ‖u • x - v • y‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 := by
    calc
      ‖u • x - v • y‖ ^ 2 =
          (u * ‖x‖ - v * ‖y‖) ^ 2 +
            2 * (u * v) * (‖x‖ * ‖y‖ - inner ℝ x y) := by
        rw [norm_sub_sq_real, norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hu0, abs_of_nonneg hv0,
          real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right]
        ring
      _ ≤ (‖x‖ - ‖y‖) ^ 2 + 2 * (‖x‖ * ‖y‖ - inner ℝ x y) :=
        add_le_add hsquare hangular
      _ = ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 := by rw [norm_sub_sq_real]; ring
  exact (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp hresult

/-- Exact relation to the existing GPTMini definition, with finite epsilon. -/
theorem rmsNormEps_eq_scaled_radial {d : ℕ} (eps : ℝ) (heps : 0 < eps)
    (hd : 0 < d) (x : EucSpace d) :
    GPTMini.rmsNormEps eps x = (1 / Real.sqrt eps) • radialMap ((d : ℝ) * eps) x := by
  have hd' : (0 : ℝ) < (d : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hd
  have he : Real.sqrt eps ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr heps).ne'
  unfold GPTMini.rmsNormEps radialMap
  rw [smul_smul, Real.sqrt_mul hd'.le]
  congr 1
  field_simp

/-- Improved global Lipschitz bound for the actual finite-epsilon RMS equation. -/
theorem rmsNormEps_lipschitz_improved {d : ℕ} (eps : ℝ) (heps : 0 < eps)
    (hd : 0 < d) (x y : EucSpace d) :
    ‖GPTMini.rmsNormEps eps x - GPTMini.rmsNormEps eps y‖ ≤
      (1 / Real.sqrt eps) * ‖x - y‖ := by
  have hd' : (0 : ℝ) < (d : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hd
  rw [rmsNormEps_eq_scaled_radial eps heps hd x,
    rmsNormEps_eq_scaled_radial eps heps hd y, ← smul_sub, norm_smul,
    Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (radialMap_nonexpansive ((d : ℝ) * eps) (mul_pos hd' heps) x y) (by positivity)

/-- Post-RMS residual scaling multiplies the improved bound by its absolute value. -/
theorem scaled_rmsNormEps_lipschitz {d : ℕ} (eps : ℝ) (heps : 0 < eps)
    (hd : 0 < d) (alpha : ℝ) (x y : EucSpace d) :
    ‖alpha • GPTMini.rmsNormEps eps x - alpha • GPTMini.rmsNormEps eps y‖ ≤
      (|alpha| / Real.sqrt eps) * ‖x - y‖ := by
  rw [← smul_sub, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  calc
    |alpha| * ‖GPTMini.rmsNormEps eps x - GPTMini.rmsNormEps eps y‖ ≤
        |alpha| * ((1 / Real.sqrt eps) * ‖x - y‖) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (rmsNormEps_lipschitz_improved eps heps hd x y)
        (abs_nonneg alpha)
    _ = (|alpha| / Real.sqrt eps) * ‖x - y‖ := by ring

/-- Nonvacuity: actual FP32 epsilon, positive width and arbitrary vectors. -/
example (x y : EucSpace 8) :
    ‖GPTMini.rmsNormEps (1 / 8388608) x - GPTMini.rmsNormEps (1 / 8388608) y‖ ≤
      (1 / Real.sqrt (1 / 8388608)) * ‖x - y‖ :=
  rmsNormEps_lipschitz_improved _ (by norm_num) (by norm_num) x y

example (t : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (radialScalar 1)
    (1 / (Real.sqrt (t ^ 2 + 1)) ^ 3) t := by
  simpa using radialScalar_hasDerivAt 1 (by norm_num) t

example : LipschitzWith 1 (radialScalar 1) := radialScalar_lipschitz 1 (by norm_num)

example (x y : EucSpace 8) : ‖radialMap 1 x - radialMap 1 y‖ ≤ ‖x - y‖ :=
  radialMap_nonexpansive 1 (by norm_num) x y

example (x : EucSpace 8) :
    GPTMini.rmsNormEps (1 / 8388608) x =
      (1 / Real.sqrt (1 / 8388608)) • radialMap (8 * (1 / 8388608)) x :=
  rmsNormEps_eq_scaled_radial _ (by norm_num) (by norm_num) x

example (x y : EucSpace 8) :
    ‖(1 / 4 : ℝ) • GPTMini.rmsNormEps (1 / 8388608) x -
      (1 / 4 : ℝ) • GPTMini.rmsNormEps (1 / 8388608) y‖ ≤
      (|(1 / 4 : ℝ)| / Real.sqrt (1 / 8388608)) * ‖x - y‖ :=
  scaled_rmsNormEps_lipschitz _ (by norm_num) (by norm_num) _ x y

#print axioms Early99Normalization.radialScalar_hasDerivAt
#print axioms Early99Normalization.radialScalar_lipschitz
#print axioms Early99Normalization.radialMap_nonexpansive
#print axioms Early99Normalization.rmsNormEps_eq_scaled_radial
#print axioms Early99Normalization.rmsNormEps_lipschitz_improved
#print axioms Early99Normalization.scaled_rmsNormEps_lipschitz

end Early99Normalization

import research.normalization_guarantees.RMSLipschitz

/-!
Local normalizer-choice analysis, plan.json targets 1--5. LayerNorm uses the
actual population variance: subtract the coordinate mean, then apply the
existing finite-epsilon RMS definition. No abstract sphere replacement or
unbiased-variance factor is used. These are real-arithmetic input bounds,
not statements about floating-point implementations or learning.
-/

namespace LayerNormAffine
open Transformer Transformer.GPTMini Early99Normalization
open scoped BigOperators

/-- The constant coordinate direction removed by featurewise mean subtraction. -/
noncomputable def ones (d : ℕ) : EucSpace d := WithLp.toLp 2 (fun _ => 1)

/-- Population coordinate mean, matching the declared LayerNorm equation. -/
noncomputable def coordinateMean {d : ℕ} (x : EucSpace d) : ℝ :=
  (∑ i, x.ofLp i) / (d : ℝ)

/-- Mean subtraction retains every centered coordinate; it is not attention centering. -/
noncomputable def center {d : ℕ} (x : EucSpace d) : EucSpace d :=
  x - coordinateMean x • ones d

/-- Finite-epsilon population-variance LayerNorm, before any affine parameters. -/
noncomputable def layerNormEps {d : ℕ} (eps : ℝ) (x : EucSpace d) : EucSpace d :=
  rmsNormEps eps (center x)

private theorem ones_norm_sq (d : ℕ) : ‖ones d‖ ^ 2 = (d : ℝ) := by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq]
  simp [ones]

private theorem inner_ones {d : ℕ} (x : EucSpace d) :
    inner ℝ (ones d) x = ∑ i, x.ofLp i := by
  rw [PiLp.inner_apply]
  simp [ones]

/-- Target 1: explicit mean subtraction removes exactly the constant-direction
energy. Positive width avoids division by zero. -/
theorem center_energy {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (x : EucSpace d) :
    ‖center x‖ ^ 2 = ‖x‖ ^ 2 - (∑ i, x.ofLp i) ^ 2 / (d : ℝ) := by
  have hd0 : (d : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hd.ne'
  rw [center, norm_sub_sq_real, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    mul_pow, sq_abs, ones_norm_sq, real_inner_smul_right,
    real_inner_comm (ones d) x, inner_ones]
  unfold coordinateMean
  field_simp
  ring

private theorem center_sub {d : ℕ} (x y : EucSpace d) :
    center x - center y = center (x - y) := by
  have hm : coordinateMean (x - y) = coordinateMean x - coordinateMean y := by
    simp [coordinateMean, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, sub_div]
  simp only [center, hm, sub_smul]
  module

/-- Target 2: mean subtraction is a Euclidean nonexpansion. -/
theorem center_nonexpansive {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (x y : EucSpace d) :
    ‖center x - center y‖ ≤ ‖x - y‖ := by
  rw [center_sub]
  have h := center_energy hd (x - y)
  have hremoved : 0 ≤ (∑ i, (x - y).ofLp i) ^ 2 / (d : ℝ) := by positivity
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (center (x - y)), norm_nonneg (x - y)]

/-- Target 3: actual positive-epsilon LayerNorm retains the RMS radius bound. -/
theorem layerNorm_radius {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (eps : ℝ) (heps : 0 < eps)
    (x : EucSpace d) : ‖layerNormEps eps x‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (d : ℝ) := by
  exact rmsNormEps_norm_le eps heps hd (center x)

/-- Target 4: centering does not enlarge the improved 1/sqrt(epsilon) RMS
input Lipschitz constant. This does not compare trained model conditioning. -/
theorem layerNorm_lipschitz {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (eps : ℝ) (heps : 0 < eps)
    (x y : EucSpace d) :
    ‖layerNormEps eps x - layerNormEps eps y‖ ≤
      (1 / Real.sqrt eps) * ‖x - y‖ := by
  calc
    _ ≤ (1 / Real.sqrt eps) * ‖center x - center y‖ :=
      rmsNormEps_lipschitz_improved eps heps hd _ _
    _ ≤ (1 / Real.sqrt eps) * ‖x - y‖ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (center_nonexpansive hd x y) (by positivity)

/-- Target 5: adding any scalar constant to every coordinate leaves LayerNorm
unchanged, even with finite epsilon. This is a local information loss, not a
claim that a residual transformer or tied readout cannot learn. -/
theorem layerNorm_shift {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (eps c : ℝ) (x : EucSpace d) :
    layerNormEps eps (x + c • ones d) = layerNormEps eps x := by
  have hd0 : (d : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hd.ne'
  have hm : coordinateMean (x + c • ones d) = coordinateMean x + c := by
    simp [coordinateMean, ones, Finset.sum_add_distrib, add_div, hd0]
  have hc : center (x + c • ones d) = center x := by
    simp only [center, hm, add_smul]
    module
  unfold layerNormEps
  rw [hc]

-- Concrete positive width/epsilon witnesses; vectors and shifts remain arbitrary.
example (x : EucSpace 8) :
    ‖center x‖ ^ 2 = ‖x‖ ^ 2 - (∑ i, x.ofLp i) ^ 2 / 8 :=
  center_energy (by norm_num) x

example (x y : EucSpace 8) : ‖center x - center y‖ ≤ ‖x - y‖ :=
  center_nonexpansive (by norm_num) x y

example (x : EucSpace 8) : ‖layerNormEps (1 / 8388608) x‖ ≤ Real.sqrt 8 :=
  layerNorm_radius (by norm_num) _ (by norm_num) x

example (x y : EucSpace 8) :
    ‖layerNormEps (1 / 8388608) x - layerNormEps (1 / 8388608) y‖ ≤
      (1 / Real.sqrt (1 / 8388608)) * ‖x - y‖ :=
  layerNorm_lipschitz (by norm_num) _ (by norm_num) x y

example (x : EucSpace 8) (c : ℝ) :
    layerNormEps (1 / 8388608) (x + c • ones 8) = layerNormEps (1 / 8388608) x :=
  layerNorm_shift (by norm_num) _ c x

#print axioms center_energy
#print axioms center_nonexpansive
#print axioms layerNorm_radius
#print axioms layerNorm_lipschitz
#print axioms layerNorm_shift
end LayerNormAffine

import research.layernorm_affine_guarantees.Centering

/-!
Local normalizer-choice analysis, plan.json targets 6--8. Affine parameters are
the actual coordinatewise gamma and beta, fixed during an input comparison.
The bound on gamma is explicit; unconstrained training does not supply a
uniform bound across optimizer steps. No learning guarantee follows.
-/

namespace LayerNormAffine
open Transformer Transformer.GPTMini Early99Normalization
open scoped BigOperators

/-- The ordinary coordinatewise learned scale, with no new hidden parameters. -/
noncomputable def diagonal {d : ℕ} (gamma : Fin d → ℝ) (x : EucSpace d) : EucSpace d :=
  WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => gamma i * x.ofLp i)

/-- The ordinary learned diagonal affine operation following normalization. -/
noncomputable def affine {d : ℕ} (gamma : Fin d → ℝ) (beta x : EucSpace d) : EucSpace d :=
  diagonal gamma x + beta

/-- Target 6: bounded coordinatewise gain controls the Euclidean operator norm. -/
theorem diagonal_bound {d : ℕ} (gamma : Fin d → ℝ) (G : ℝ) (hG : 0 ≤ G)
    (hgamma : ∀ i, |gamma i| ≤ G) (x : EucSpace d) :
    ‖diagonal gamma x‖ ≤ G * ‖x‖ := by
  have hs : ‖diagonal gamma x‖ ^ 2 ≤ G ^ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq, EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq, Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    change (gamma i * x.ofLp i) ^ 2 ≤ G ^ 2 * (x.ofLp i) ^ 2
    rw [mul_pow]
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (sq_nonneg _)
    apply sq_le_sq.mpr
    simpa only [abs_of_nonneg hG] using hgamma i
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hG (norm_nonneg _))).mp
  simpa only [mul_pow] using hs

private theorem diagonal_sub {d : ℕ} (gamma : Fin d → ℝ) (x y : EucSpace d) :
    diagonal gamma (x - y) = diagonal gamma x - diagonal gamma y := by
  ext i
  simp [diagonal, mul_sub]

private theorem transfer_bounds {d : ℕ} (N : EucSpace d → EucSpace d)
    (R L G : ℝ) (hG : 0 ≤ G)
    (hR : ∀ x, ‖N x‖ ≤ R) (hL : ∀ x y, ‖N x - N y‖ ≤ L * ‖x - y‖)
    (gamma : Fin d → ℝ) (hgamma : ∀ i, |gamma i| ≤ G)
    (beta x y : EucSpace d) :
    ‖affine gamma beta (N x)‖ ≤ G * R + ‖beta‖ ∧
      ‖affine gamma beta (N x) - affine gamma beta (N y)‖ ≤ (G * L) * ‖x - y‖ := by
  constructor
  · change ‖diagonal gamma (N x) + beta‖ ≤ G * R + ‖beta‖
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖diagonal gamma (N x)‖ + ‖beta‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ G * ‖N x‖ + ‖beta‖ :=
        add_le_add (diagonal_bound gamma G hG hgamma (N x)) (le_refl ‖beta‖)
      _ ≤ G * R + ‖beta‖ :=
        add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hR x) hG) (le_refl ‖beta‖)
  · change ‖(diagonal gamma (N x) + beta) - (diagonal gamma (N y) + beta)‖ ≤
      (G * L) * ‖x - y‖
    rw [add_sub_add_right_eq_sub, ← diagonal_sub]
    calc
      _ ≤ G * ‖N x - N y‖ := diagonal_bound gamma G hG hgamma (N x - N y)
      _ ≤ G * (L * ‖x - y‖) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hL x y) hG
      _ = (G * L) * ‖x - y‖ := by ring

/-- Target 7: learned affine RMS retains bounds that explicitly depend on gamma
and beta. Bias cancels in fixed-parameter input differences, not output radii. -/
theorem affine_rms_bounds {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (eps : ℝ) (heps : 0 < eps)
    (gamma : Fin d → ℝ) (G : ℝ) (hG : 0 ≤ G) (hgamma : ∀ i, |gamma i| ≤ G)
    (beta x y : EucSpace d) :
    ‖affine gamma beta (rmsNormEps eps x)‖ ≤ G * Real.sqrt (d : ℝ) + ‖beta‖ ∧
      ‖affine gamma beta (rmsNormEps eps x) - affine gamma beta (rmsNormEps eps y)‖ ≤
        (G / Real.sqrt eps) * ‖x - y‖ := by
  have h := transfer_bounds (rmsNormEps eps) (Real.sqrt (d : ℝ)) (1 / Real.sqrt eps)
    G hG (rmsNormEps_norm_le eps heps hd)
    (rmsNormEps_lipschitz_improved eps heps hd) gamma hgamma beta x y
  simpa only [mul_one_div] using h

/-- Target 8: learned affine LayerNorm has the same explicit radius and input
sensitivity bounds; its shift invariance is a separate structural property. -/
theorem affine_layerNorm_bounds {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (eps : ℝ) (heps : 0 < eps)
    (gamma : Fin d → ℝ) (G : ℝ) (hG : 0 ≤ G) (hgamma : ∀ i, |gamma i| ≤ G)
    (beta x y : EucSpace d) :
    ‖affine gamma beta (layerNormEps eps x)‖ ≤ G * Real.sqrt (d : ℝ) + ‖beta‖ ∧
      ‖affine gamma beta (layerNormEps eps x) - affine gamma beta (layerNormEps eps y)‖ ≤
        (G / Real.sqrt eps) * ‖x - y‖ := by
  have h := transfer_bounds (layerNormEps eps) (Real.sqrt (d : ℝ)) (1 / Real.sqrt eps)
    G hG (layerNorm_radius hd eps heps) (layerNorm_lipschitz hd eps heps)
    gamma hgamma beta x y
  simpa only [mul_one_div] using h

example (x : EucSpace 8) : ‖diagonal (fun _ => (2 : ℝ)) x‖ ≤ 2 * ‖x‖ :=
  diagonal_bound _ _ (by norm_num) (by intro i; norm_num) x

example (x y : EucSpace 8) :=
  affine_rms_bounds (by norm_num : 0 < 8) (1 / 8388608) (by norm_num)
    (fun _ => (2 : ℝ)) 2 (by norm_num) (by intro i; norm_num) (ones 8) x y

example (x y : EucSpace 8) :=
  affine_layerNorm_bounds (by norm_num : 0 < 8) (1 / 8388608) (by norm_num)
    (fun _ => (2 : ℝ)) 2 (by norm_num) (by intro i; norm_num) (ones 8) x y

#print axioms diagonal_bound
#print axioms affine_rms_bounds
#print axioms affine_layerNorm_bounds
end LayerNormAffine
